metadata.description: Red tiles form a flying bird with swept wings and a forked tail. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Twin flank corridors surround the motif, with tidal coves along the lower route. 4 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 8 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
